strategies.overview: Raikou is a decent pivot and setup sweeper, using its high Speed and Special Attack, along with Calm Mind boosts, to wear down opposing special walls like Copperajah and Bronzong. Its typing allows it to resist Kilowattrel's STAB moves and Brave Bird from Flamigo, which enables it to begin setting up with Calm Mind or use its high Speed to revenge kill non-Choice Scarf Flamigo. It has a variety of coverage moves, such as Scald and Shadow Ball, but to actually threaten the Ground- and Grass-types that wall it like Flygon, Gligar, Swampert, and Tsareena, it usually requires Tera Blast Fairy or Tera Blast Ice. Furthermore, Raikou usually only has space for one coverage move, so it has to choose which checks to target: Tera Blast Fairy doesn't seriously threaten Gligar; Tera Blast Ice doesn't do much to Swampert; and Scald is impotent against Covert Cloak Tsareena, and if it doesn't burn Flygon, that foe is still very threatening. While Raikou can, given either time or sufficient Calm Mind boosts, break special walls like Bronzong, they can threaten it back with Earthquake. Raikou can also be picked off by physical Choice Scarf users like Flygon, Flamigo, and Infernape. In addition, Raikou faces competition from other common Electric-types Kilowattrel and Toxtricity, with the former being faster and Ground immune and the latter having more immediate power and an easier time setting up.
strategies.comments:
Other Options

Tera Blast Grass can be used to Swampert, but it has very few targets, as Scald already hits foes like Rhyperior. A set of Substitute / Calm Mind / Thunderbolt / Scald, Tera Blast, or Protect can be run on Raikou so that it can lean more into its identity of a setup sweeper, allowing it to simultaneously avoid status attempts as well as more easily boost its stats. Raikou can utilize Aura Sphere, along with Tera Fighting, to handle specially defensive Steel- and Dark-types like Copperajah, Incineroar, and Wo-Chien, but it loses the ability to threaten non-Rhyperior Ground-types at all. It can also slot Roar over Volt Switch to force out foes that may try to set up alongside it with Calm Mind like Bronzong and Sylveon. Discharge can be used to threaten faster foes like Choice Scarf Munkidori and Infernape with paralysis at the cost of Thunderbolt's power.

Checks and Counters

Ground-types: Raikou is threatened by a variety of common Ground-types like Flygon, Gligar, and Swampert, and it usually requires Tera Blast to deal with them. However, it struggles to hit all of them with any single coverage move: Tera Blast Fairy does not hit Gligar super effectively, Tera Blast Ice does not deal significant damage to Swampert, and Scald only threatens a burn on Flygon.

Special Walls: Specially defensive walls like Copperajah, Bronzong, and Wo-Chien are difficult for Raikou to break without several boosts, and the former two often carry Earthquake to hit it super effectively, while Wo-Chien threatens to remove its item with Knock Off and sap Raikou's health with Leech Seed. However, none of these foes are Electric immune, so they can be worn down over time by being forced to repeatedly switch into Raikou's attacks.

Revenge Killers: Raikou's Speed is very good, but Choice Scarf users still threaten to revenge kill it, particularly physical attackers that don't care about its Calm Mind boosts like Flygon, Flamigo, and Infernape. Priority moves, such as Basculegion-M's Aqua Jet, Decidueye's Shadow Sneak, and Arcanine's Extreme Speed, can also pick it off if it is sufficiently weakened.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Set Details

Volt Switch allows Raikou to keep up momentum against and chip common switch-ins like Tsareena, Altaria, and Wo-Chien. Scald hits Electric-immune foes like Flygon, Swampert, and Kilowattrel while threatening with burns. Both Tera Blast Fairy and Ice hit Flygon, Altaria, and Breloom super effectively; however, the former offers a reliable defensive typing whereas the latter can hit a few more foes such as Gligar and Rhyperior, though Tera Ice leaves Raikou open to being revenge killed by Close Combat Barraskewda as well as Choice Scarf Flamigo and Infernape. Shadow Ball, often boosted by Tera Ghost, has solid neutral coverage, but Thunderbolt can provide a strong STAB attack that doesn't force Raikou to leave the field and, consequently, lose its Calm Mind boosts. Heavy-Duty Boots allows Raikou to pivot in and out more freely without concerns about entry hazards, while Leftovers grants longevity and better supports Substitute sets. In addition to Tera Blast Grass's ability to hit Ground-types like Swampert and Gastrodon, Tera Grass gives Raikou a resistance to Ground-type attacks. Beyond boosting Shadow Ball, Tera Ghost also gives it an immunity to Fighting-type attacks from foes like Infernape, Heracross, and Scyther.

Raikou benefits from teammates that can switch into Ground-type attacks from foes that wall it, like Flygon and Swampert. As a result, teammates that can take advantage of Ground-types, such as Swords Dance Decidueye, Trailblaze Scyther, and Iron Defense Bronzong support it well. Particularly on sets that pivot with Volt Switch, entry hazard-setting teammates like Gligar, Diancie, and Gastrodon can help it wear down opposing walls, along with Knock Off users like Incineroar and Alolan Muk to remove Heavy-Duty Boots and Leftovers. Pivoting teammates like Flamigo, Flygon, and Basculegion-M can help bring Raikou in and weaken foes like Vaporeon and Avalugg. Other special attackers like Toxtricity, Uxie, and Munkidori can also help Raikou overload special walls like Gastrodon, Copperajah, and Alolan Muk. On non-Heavy-Duty Boots sets, hazard removal from teammates such as Tsareena and Avalugg can help Raikou pivot in and out more freely.

movesets.name: Offensive Pivot
movesets.description:
Set Details

Scald is an excellent coverage move on Raikou, melting Ground-types like Hippowdon, Krookodile, and Mamoswine while also threatening to burn common checks like Cyclizar and Umbreon. Aura Sphere allows Raikou to hit Dark-, Normal-, and Steel-types like Bisharp, Cyclizar, and Hisuian Goodra for considerable damage. Heavy-Duty Boots prevents Raikou from taking entry hazard chip damage, helping to form robust VoltTurn cores with teammates like Cyclizar and Galarian Zapdos; Choice Specs is an alternative to threaten 2HKOs on walls like Cyclizar and offensive Hisuian Goodra. Tera Water removes Raikou's Ground weakness and boosts the damage output of Scald, helping take on threats like Mamoswine and Rhyperior.

Raikou is an excellent choice for balance and bulky offense teams that want a fast, powerful Volt Switch user to pair with other staples like Galarian Zapdos and Gengar. Stealth Rock setters like Jirachi and Rhyperior make for great teammates, ensuring that the opposition gets worn down more effectively by the VoltTurn core Raikou forms with partners like Barraskewda and Cyclizar. Similarly, Chesnaught is a great teammate for its ability to sponge the Ground-type attacks thrown at Raikou from foes like Hippowdon and Rhyperior, which it can use to set up Spikes to further rack up hazard chip damage. Choice Specs Raikou appreciates teammates like Cyclizar and Noivern that help with entry hazard removal, allowing it to become a bit more threatening offensively without sacrificing its longevity. Talonflame also offers hazard removal support and can handle foes like Krookodile and Bisharp for Raikou, while Raikou can take on the Steel-types like Empoleon and Jirachi in return.

movesets.name: Calm Mind
movesets.description:
Set Details

Calm Mind, in conjunction with Pressure, allows Raikou to become an excellent setup sweeper that can hit hard immediately while also handling opposing Calm Mind threats like Reuniclus and Suicune. Scald lets Raikou take on Ground-types like Krookodile, Mamoswine, and Rhyperior, as well as punish walls like Cyclizar and Umbreon with the chance to burn. Aura Sphere can be used to hit Normal- and Steel-types like Cyclizar and Hisuian Goodra; Substitute is an alternative that grants Raikou safety from status while setting up, protection from moves like Knock Off and Dragon Tail, and allows it to PP stall foes like Suicune with Pressure and Calm Mind. Leftovers allows Raikou to maintain health while attempting to setup and sweep, while Heavy-Duty Boots can be used instead to mitigate entry hazard chip damage. Tera Water removes the weakness to Ground and boosts the damage of Scald, which helps Raikou OHKO foes like Krookodile and Mamoswine, as well as OHKO Hippowdon at +1. Tera Dark can be used on Substitute sets to prevent Psychic Noise Reuniclus and Slowbro from disrupting Raikou while it sets up.

Calm Mind Raikou fits well on balance and bulky offense teams, using its great Speed and coverage moves to rack up boosts and threaten to sweep late-game. Status spreaders like Talonflame and Umbreon are excellent teammates for Raikou; Talonflmae can use Will-O-Wisp to burn physical attackers like Bisharp, as well as check foes like Krookodile and Galarian Zapdos, while Umbreon can use Toxic to wear down foes like Cresselia and opposing Umbreon. Stealth Rock setters like Krookodile and Rhyperior can help break through Raikou's checks, like Alolan Muk and Hisuian Goodra, as can wallbreaker teammates like Basculegion-F and Mienshao, which also offer pivot support. Gastrodon is a notable Raikou counter, being immune to Thunderbolt and using Storm Drain to absorb Raikou's Scald, so teammates like Amoonguss and Breloom that can threaten it are much appreciated. Cresselia and Gardevoir are great teammates as well, offering to restore its HP with Lunar Dance and Healing Wish, respectively, to give Raikou a second chance at a setup sweep.

strategies.overview:
Draft Order: Round 5 onwards

Price Range: 8-9 points

Overview: Raikou is a good offensive pivot with a solid Speed tier and access to useful coverage moves like Scald and Aura Sphere, and it can also function as a sweeper with Calm Mind. Furthermore, it can pivot around with Volt Switch to support teammates with momentum. However, without a Calm Mind boost, Raikou lacks the offensive power to break past special walls. It also struggles against Grass- and Dragon-types, as it is prone to being worn down by them and lacks coverage options. Lastly, Raikou is overshadowed by other middle-tier special attackers with a similar price range and better role compression.
strategies.comments:
Common Roles

Setup Sweeper: Raikou can create offensive pressure by setting up with Calm Mind alongside Substitute to take advantage of passive walls. It can use the necessary coverage to deal with its checks and attempt to pull off a sweep. Raikou primarily requires the item Leftovers with Substitute to maintain longevity while setting up Calm Minds.

Bulky Pivot: Raikou has the well-rounded stats needed to run a bulky pivot set to check special attackers. This set takes some pressure off teammates having to deal with the aforementioned threats and can utilize Volt Switch to gain momentum throughout the game.

Common Moves

Primary STAB Moves: Thunderbolt, Discharge, Volt Switch

Setup Moves: Calm Mind

Utility Moves: Substitute, Thunder Wave, Roar

Coverage: Scald, Aura Sphere, Shadow Ball, Extrasensory

Niche Moves

Charge Beam: While this move is inferior to Calm Mind as a consistent setup option, it can prove useful on pivot sets, with which Raikou can generate enough Special Attack boosts to wallbreak or sweep.

Snarl: Snarl allows Raikou to disrupt special attackers by reducing their Special Attack. This move also works when dealing with slower special sweepers, as their sweeping capabilities are also hindered.

Dual Screens: In certain matchups where offensive Raikou struggles to make progress, it can support teammates with Light Screen and Reflect. On this set, it often pivots out with Volt Switch to get momentum and position effectively for its sweepers.

Common Items

Heavy-Duty Boots: Raikou is expected to enter the field multiple times to pivot or attempt to sweep with Calm Mind. As such, Heavy-Duty Boots is a useful item for preserving its health against entry hazards.

Leftovers: Leftovers grants Raikou passive recovery, which is needed when attempting to sweep with a Substitute + Calm Mind set or Pressure stall with Substitute + Protect.

Niche Items

Shuca Berry: Since Raikou's only type weakness is Ground, this item can come in handy to give Raikou another turn to deal good damage back with Scald or another coverage move.

Chesto Berry: If Raikou is expected to withstand notable damage while attempting to sweep with Calm Mind, it can utilize Rest to heal off any chip damage it receives and proceed to clean from there.

Expert Belt: Expert Belt gives a substantial boost to Raikou's coverage moves, granting it opportunities to get certain 2HKOs or OHKOs on opposing Pokemon that it would not be able to otherwise.

Assault Vest: Raikou can make the most use of its pivot role to serve as a soft check to special threats while attaining momentum for teammates with Volt Switch.

Tera

Raikou can make good use of certain Tera types to set up against its dedicated checks. Tera Flying and Grass help with Raikou's Ground weakness. In addition, Tera Flying can also let Raikou take advantage of Grass-types and break past them with Tera Blast. Lastly, Tera Fairy can provide it with a coverage option and immunity against Dragon-types. While Raikou can utilize Terastallization quite well, it should be known that you lose out on the chance to use a high-tier Tera Captain by choosing it as one, which means that you have to pick up an additional middle-tier Pokemon that can use Terastallization alongside it. This opportunity cost can weaken offensive team structures, as only a few solid teams can use Tera Raikou with substantial success. Furthermore, there are other Pokemon in a similar price range such as Galarian Moltres, Haxorus, Primarina, and Sandy Shocks that can serve as more suitable Tera Captains than Raikou.

Draft Strategy

Raikou should be picked up later in the draft and used on offensive or balance teams that appreciate a fast special pivot that can generate momentum for them. It is advised to pair it with solid physical attackers like Garchomp and Meowscarada to handle its checks, while in return, Raikou can get these attackers on the field with Volt Switch.

Other Pivots: Raikou appreciates teammates that can complement its own pivoting role and create a VoltTurn core. This can greatly support other wallbreakers and sweepers, and having more pivots can give Raikou an opportunity to run a wallbreaking or sweeping set.

Physical Wallbreakers: Raikou lacks the damage output to break past special walls; therefore, having physical wallbreakers to come in after a Volt Switch and heavily weaken them is highly valued.

Entry Hazard Control: Raikou appreciates good entry hazard setters such as Garchomp, Greninja, Ting-Lu, and Glimmora to accumulate chip damage on special walls, enabling it to get multiple 2HKOs on them. It is also recommended to pair Raikou with Pokemon that can remove hazards. Several good examples are Great Tusk, Corviknight, Iron Treads, and Scizor. Without proper hazard control, Raikou's pivoting role is limited without using Heavy-Duty Boots.

Checks and Counters

*Electric-resistant Pokemon: Raikou's coverage moves do not hold up well against bulky Grass-, Dragon-, and Ground-type Pokemon. Grass-types can wear it down quite easily and heal off any damage they receive. Raikou also struggles to break past Dragon-types, and in return, it can be revenge killed or exploited for setup opportunities. Lastly, Ground-types pose a threat to Raikou, as they threaten to OHKO it quite easily if its coverage moves do not deal enough damage to defeat them.

Special Walls: Certain special walls like Ting-Lu, Galarian Slowking, Hydrapple, and Clodsire can shrug off any attacks Raikou throws at them and proceed to gradually chip it down or recover from the damage received.

Faster Threats: While Raikou has a good Speed tier, it is prone to getting revenge killed by naturally faster pokemon such as Meowscarada, Iron Valiant, Iron Boulder, and Cinderace. In addition, Choice Scarf users like Urshifu-S, Landorus-T, Infernape, and Zarude can easily outspeed and potentially KO it.
